$comment: THE single source of truth for the Motion Master offer. The landing page, the MCP server, the plugin manifest and the docs all read this. If a price, a tier list or a rendering promise changes, it changes here and nowhere else. Nothing in this file may promise a number that has not been decided: hostedRenderAllowance is null until the founder sets it.

status.note: The founder is not selling this at the moment. The whole package is used personally. The paid terms below are recorded, not published, so that a later launch is one switch rather than a rebuild. Nothing on the page may imply a purchase is available while onSale is false.
status.summary: Motion Master is not on sale. It is the founder's own motion-design agent, used in-house.

summary: Motion Master is a paid, one-time licence: $99 Solo or $399 Studio. One payment, no subscription.
licenceKey: The licence key is delivered by email after checkout. It unlocks the paid tier of the plugin; nothing in this server phones home to check it.

tiers.label: Solo
includes: The full motion skill pack — motion doctrine, GSAP, Remotion, HyperFrames, the craft law, 60 film styles and the full prompt library
The MCP server: plan_video, build_composition, build_hyperframes_composition, mix_footage, and the prompt library with its enhancer
Motion tokens, four scene starters and a 3,900-item open-source prompt library
Renders on your own machine, no per-minute fee
Commercial use — upstream licences and attribution stay in the package

tiers.label: Studio
includes: The Montage bridge (AGPL-3.0) for footage you own
Hosted rendering, with an allowance in your licence
Commercial use, and the bridge ships under AGPL-3.0

local.note: Compositions render on your own machine with Remotion (npx remotion render ...). There is no per-minute fee.

hosted.allowanceNote: The size of the allowance is not decided yet, so no number is published. The allowance is confirmed in the checkout receipt, and the size is a number we will publish here before launch.
hosted.billingNote: Nothing is ever charged automatically. If you want more than the allowance, you choose it and you pay for it.
hosted.note: Studio can render on our machines. The MCP server never renders anything itself.

domain.note: The domain word is confirmed and the TLD is not. No URL with a TLD may be published by the site, the plugin, the MCP server or the docs. The one place it is recorded is plugins/motion-master/assets/brand.json.
